source_behavior.summary: SiteSettings exposes a bilingual Back to sites / العودة للمواقع action to /sites from the source site-not-found empty state.
source_behavior.wordpress_behavior: none; this control does not call or mutate WordPress
source_behavior.success_semantics: browser navigation only; no success toast, mutation receipt, or synthetic state

laravel_adaptation.visible_control: Back to sites / العودة للمواقع, selected from the authoritative Laravel locale

adaptation_note: The ASP.NET control is rendered when the source service returns no site. Laravel intentionally preserves its stricter fail-closed SiteSettingsReadController behavior: missing or foreign site IDs are rejected with 404 before the Blade view renders. The same recovery intent is therefore exposed on the real tenant-scoped Site Settings page without weakening that IDOR boundary.
runtime_path: authenticated user enters the explicit tenant/site Site Settings route
auth and tenant.context activate the current tenant membership
the requested Site is resolved with explicit active-tenant tenant_id plus route site ID and missing/foreign direct IDs fail 404
the rendered view receives tenant exclusively from active TenantContext through the controller
Back to sites resolves the named canonical.workspace.sites route using that server-authoritative tenant slug
the destination requires tenant.view and sites.view and renders the real Sites workspace backed by the tenant-scoped Sites API

tenant_isolation.target_tenant_source: server-authoritative tenant slug supplied by SiteSettingsReadController after TenantContext validation

runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: the destination Sites workspace reads the real tenant-scoped Site collection
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no domain mutation occurs

terminality.reason: The source recovery navigation is adapted to the real tenant-scoped Site Settings runtime, derives a real Sites destination only from active server tenant context, preserves stricter missing/foreign-site 404 behavior, adds no mutation or fake success, and is covered by focused authorization and tenant-isolation tests.
